text:
Resets a File Storage, including all files.
ResetAllFiles resets a File Storage to the initial state, containing only the files which were
deployed from the manifest, with their initial content. Afterwards, the File Storage will appear as
if it was newly installed from the current manifest.
It will fail with kResourceBusy when the File Storage is currently open, or when it is modified by
a call from another thread to UpdatePersistency, CleanUpPersistency, ResetPersistency,
RecoverAllFiles, or ResetAllFiles.
